name: luminescent-slash-after-another-attack-costs-two-less-and-gets-plus-two
notes: Luminescent Slash (y8BNOi4rwD): "[Mordred Bonus] This card costs 2 less to activate for each other attack card you've activated this turn. [Mordred Bonus] +2 POWER for each other attack card you've activated this turn." The champion is Aurelian Regent. Dauntless Assault (its [Mordred Bonus] On Attack wakes the champion up) is activated first (3 reserve, 4 damage); then Luminescent Slash costs 5 - 2 = THREE reserve payments and deals 6 + 2 = 8: player 2's champion has taken 4 + 8 = 12 damage in total.

rulesClauses: [Mordred Bonus] This card costs 2 less to activate for each other attack card you've activated this turn.
[Mordred Bonus] Luminescent Slash gets +2 POWER for each other attack card you've activated this turn.
